notes: Two branches each repeat their own names (مالك written in both), so they are separate groups with a null tail; the first branch is written only to مالك and the text gives no further names for it
«- قال الحسن في حديثه عن أبيه، ثم اتفقوا -» names a different transmitter (أبيه) for the same saying: stored as a variant of the Hasan branch, not a route
«رواه ابن وهب وعثمان بن عمر عن مالك» is Abu Dawud's remark naming other transmitters: a variant, partial as written
«فذكر معناه» and the remark about al-Qa'nabi and al-Nufayli are wording notes; left out
The Prophet is the end; Abu Hurayra is the last link
